name: Jude
source:
A quiet, collected young man who helps his elderly grandparents run a bakery in Peachleaf Town. He's not one for too many words and generally prefers to keep to himself. He often has trouble expressing himself and can come off as cold. 

Fun fact: He's a total granny's boy. 

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/peachleaf-valley/]official website[/url]]
